The perfect mix of comedy, fun, and full family entertainment, that’s Daadi Ki Shaadi for you!
A RTake Studios, BEINGU Studios & Shimla Talkies Production

Cast: Neetu Kapoor, Kapil Sharma, Sarath Kumar, Sadiaa Khateeb, Riddhima Kapoor
